items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account, leading to account takeover and access to private customer data.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass (B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Two Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Extensions leading to Remote Code Execution
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Amasty Order Attributes allows unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary executable files to a Magento store, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie without authentication or admin session.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Auth Bypass) Vulnerability
items.summary: This incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the application.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento's REST API
items.summary: The PolyShell vulnerability is a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files, potentially leading to remote code execution or account takeover.
